Title: Nasal Dryness Hits Up To 65% of CPAP Users - Here's Why

Description:
Up to 65% of people using a CPAP machine report nasal dryness, and airflow alone isn't the only cause. CPAP therapy without enough humidification, frequent air travel, and forced-air home heating all strip moisture from the nasal lining.

Humidify your CPAP and raise the setting, spray saline before and during flights, and run a bedroom humidifier all winter — nasal dryness gets noticeably better.
